DOCUMENTATION

Using the evidence

Search the table by title, country or topic. Choose a report title to open its detail page. Use the back link to return to the same search and sort order.

Read the methods, findings and evidence limits before applying a result to a business case. Keep analyst assessments separate from source findings. Source links and PDF page references are provided on each detail page.

Download the CSV for analysis or Power BI. It contains all 28 published records, regardless of the current search. Each row uses evaluation_id as its stable key. Copy evidence notes from the detail page to retain the findings, boundaries and source locators.
